name: Overwork Empire
detailed_description:
This is a business simulation + tower defense + card game.

Cards are divided into construction cards, employment cards, skill cards, and beverage cards.

In the preparation stage before work, players can use construction cards to expand the site and build facilities, and use employment cards to hire employees according to project requirements. Facilities are divided into R&D department, food department and power generation department. Players need to allocate talent resources to various departments to keep the company running

During the work stage, players use skill cards to make the escaped employees lose their will to resist and return to their workstations to continue working overtime. Or flip the card to become a beverage card to increase the energy of employees. Using skill cards or beverage cards will consume a fixed number of action points. After refreshing the card every 7 seconds, the action points will also be restored to the maximum value.

Players can develop multiple projects. When there is a shortage of manpower and funds in the early stage, develop outsourced projects to accumulate funds. When the conditions are met, you can develop self-developed projects. Unlike outsourced projects, self-developed projects can continue to generate income for a certain period of time after completion, and have the opportunity to be nominated for a series of awards such as the best game of the month.

When a player achieves the award-winning achievement for the first time, he will be involved in a plagiarism lawsuit. From now on, the plagiarism function will be unlocked, but the cost is that you will be sued for each plagiarism.

If the player does not have enough funds due to misoperation, he can borrow money from the bank. Before repayment, he cannot borrow again.

News events will occur every week in the game, which are divided into 4 sections: social livelihood, financial consultation, industry express and company development. The occurrence of events will pose challenges to the development of the company.

Players can use resources to unlock new company systems to reduce the pressure of dealing with challenges.

The game has multiple endings, including 1 good ending and 3 bad endings.

short_description: This is a business simulation + tower defense + card game. Players will play the role of the boss, use cards to build facilities, allocate talents, and force overtime to make profits. Players will jump out of the perspective of workers and experience the overtime culture as operators.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10
  • Processor: intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3050 or AMD rx5600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10
  • Processor: intel Core i7-13700H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
